newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close at new high following U.S.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close at new high following U.S.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse rose from the opening on Friday in line with gains on Wall Street and closed at a new all-time high but was expected to fall back in the New Year.
The Stockholm general index climbed 0.79 percent to 2344.43, toppling the previous high seven days earlier. Turnover was a fairly quiet 2.13 billion crowns.
Trade was expected to stay quiet on Monday but pick up again on Thursday when the market reopens.
"We'll probably see some profit taking in the New Year," said one broker.
The drugs sector was the best performing branch, rising 1.75 percent. It was led by Pharmacia & Upjohn that closed seven higher at 275 crowns in line with U.S. gains.
Drugs bluechip Astra rose 5.5 to 328 crowns which was seen as a rebound after losses on Monday.
"There is technical support at around the 322-325 crown level," said one broker.
Telecoms giant Ericsson was actively traded after Motorola gains in New York. It closed 1.5 crowns higher at 208.5 crowns.
